(3) Meri parwaaz
Meri parwaaz hui shehr e Musayyab pe tamam
Mujhko ta hadd e nazar aya nazar lashkar e Shaam
Main badha aage, ke mil jaye mujhe mere Imam (a.s.)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ruk gaye mere qadam..Ruk gaye mere qadam ...
Jaha Shabbir (a.s.) ko insaanon ne tanha dekha
Meri aankhon ne waha laakhon ka majma dekha
Ambiya bhi the, Malaek the ajinnah the khade
<<DIVIDER>>
Aisi noorani bashar the ke nazar na thehre
Ek jaanib the Rasool (s.a.w.a.) e Arabi, Ek jaanib the Ali (a.s.), Ek jaanib the Hasan Ibn e Ali (a.s.)
Phir na aankhon ko meri taab rahi, Maine Zahra (s.a.) ki sawari dekhi
Apni nazron ko jhukakar, jo hataya peeche
<<DIVIDER>>
Nabi Adam (a.s.), Nabi Moosa (a.s.), Nabi Haroon (a.s.) dikhe
Isa (a.s.) o Yusuf (a.s.) o Yaqoob (a.s.) bhi pehlu me mile
Hud (a.s.) aur Lut (a.s.) kahi, Nuh (a.s.) kahi, Khizr (a.s.) kahi
Zikriya (a.s.), Yarmiya (a.s.) aur Shees (s.a.) o Sulaiman (a.s.) bhi the
<<DIVIDER>>
Mukhtasir yeh ke Nabi saare waha the maujood
Unke peeche thi Malaek ki qatarein maujood
Farishte gaan e Jahannum, farisht e gaan e Behisht
Israeel, Israfeel, Mikaeel, Dardaeel
<<DIVIDER>>
Rizwan aur Maalik, Fitrus wa Jibraeel
(4) Saath Shabbir ke maujood the sab Aali Maqaam
Maine Socha ke kaha jaye bhala adna Ghulam
Mujhko pehchaan bhi paye ya Nahi mere Imam
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye ummeed mere dil me murjhane lagi Ke achanak wahe se yeh sada aane lagi
Aao Zafar, Aao Zafar
Aao Zafar tumhe Shabbir ne bulwaya hain

(5) Pohoncha qadmon me kaha Maula Shah e Jinn o Bashar
Ho salaam aap pe is jinn ka Shah e Jinn o Bashar
Hukm pe aap ke hu fidya Shah e Jinn o Bashar
Dil mera doob gaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab yeh Maula ne kaha
Tum palat jaao agar
Hone aaye ho fida

(6) Maine Maula se kaha izn mujhe de Shah e Deen
Bole Shabbir yeh Jinnat ki hain jung nahi
Main yeh bola kaha insaan hain, darinde hain sabhi
Bole Shabbir ke Nana ki yeh ummat hain meri
<<DIVIDER>>
Inhe tum kuch na kaho, Inhe tum kuch na kaho
Tum hi batlao jiyu kaise bhala main Zafar
Aao dikhlau tumhe Karbobala main Zafar
Janisaaron ke janaze dekho
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere pyaaron ke yeh laashe dekho
Tukde Qasim ka sarapa dekho
Zakhmi Akbar ka kaleja dekho
Kahi Abbas ke bazu, Kahi Asghar ka gulu
